major.summary: An exact transition retry fails once the Action projection has advanced beyond the retried event.
major.evidence: Replay recognition required the current projection to remain at expectedVersion + 1 and the requested target status. After any later legal transition, the service rejected the original immutable event as stale without reading it.
major.impact: Delayed delivery retries are not idempotent even though the event ledger retains the complete semantic transition fact.
major.recommendation: Resolve the event at expectedVersion + 1 first, compare its complete semantic coordinates and fact hash, and return the current Action with that historical event when it matches. Preserve conflicting-event detection and add delayed service and real-repository coverage.

major.summary: The transition Zod contract accepts lifecycle coordinates that the service and database reject.
major.evidence: The contract rejected only version-zero mismatches, no-ops and transitions back to approved. It explicitly accepted approved to implemented and other illegal pairs.
major.impact: The declared trust-boundary contract does not describe the accepted Action state machine and permits invalid coordinates to reach deeper layers.
major.recommendation: Use one shared legal-transition predicate in both the Zod contract and service, and cover every legal and incompatible status pair in contract tests.

do_not_change.summary: Preserve project-leading composite foreign keys and cascades.
do_not_change.evidence: The normalized graph rejects cross-project attachment and preserves Recommendation/run deletion semantics.
do_not_change.impact: Weakening these keys would compromise tenant isolation and evidence-chain cleanup.
do_not_change.recommendation: Keep the existing composite boundaries unchanged during repair.

do_not_change.summary: Preserve fact-hash-gated atomic Action and event writes with normalized targets.
do_not_change.evidence: The writer couples the projection and immutable event under compare-and-set semantics while target rows remain canonical normalized relations.
do_not_change.impact: Weakening the writer would allow partial graphs or event/projection divergence under concurrency.
do_not_change.recommendation: Repair replay interpretation in the service without changing the atomic writer design.
